Komplett ASA: Mandatory notification of trade - primary insiders

 2026-10-29 20:03:44

Oslo, 29 October 2026: Group CEO Vebjørn Torsetnes has bought a total of 16 000 shares in Komplett ASA at a weighted average price of NOK 5.90 per share.

In addition, Håkon Haugli, a related party to Torsetnes, has bought 8 000 shares in Komplett ASA at a price of NOK 5.90 per share.
The shares were acquired on the Oslo Stock Exchange.
Following this transaction, Torsetnes and related parties own 54 000 shares in Komplett ASA.
For further inquiries, please contact:
Thomas Røkke, CFO 
Thomas.Rokke@komplett.com 
About Komplett ASA 
Komplett Group is a leading online-first electronics and IT products retailer, operating in Norway, Sweden and Denmark. Serving customers in the B2C, B2B and distribution markets, the Group is deeply focused on delivering best-in-class customer experience, built through decades of know-how, expertise and deep customer commitment. Komplett Group operates an efficient and scalable business model that supports cost leadership and enables a competitive product offering. 
This information is subject to the disclosure requirements pursuant to Section 5 -12 of the Norwegian Securities Trading Act.
